**Description**


`JOB_STATE_ prefix` is not necessary in `airflow.providers.google.cloud.hooks.dataflow.DataflowJobStatus` states names and would be nice to simplify this.
https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/8553#discussion_r418995083
https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/8550#discussion_r419002073

review_comments: Do you still need to keep the values in the `JOB_STATE_DONE` format to match Dataflow returned statuses?

I agree. If the API uses a prefix, we can keep it on our side aalso.
